title: Kasim Raja — Preventing Crime Before It Happens | Cybercrime, AI & Modern Policing | Expressions
description: Deputy Commissioner of Police Kasim Raja joins Expressions for a conversation on cybercrime, digital safety, AI's role in policing,and the lessons he learned directly from Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam. With 30 years of service transforming Bangalore's police force through technology and human judgment, he shares practical tips on spotting scams, protecting your digital footprint, and why prevention will always beat punishment.

title: Synopsys to cut chip fab manufacturing control software in shift to AI design, sources say
description: SEOUL, July 7 (Reuters) - U.S. ⁠chip design giant Synopsys plans to stop offering a suite of manufacturing process control software used by global semiconductor makers, six sources ⁠briefed on the matter said, as it seeks to divert resources to higher-margin offerings such as AI design.

title: Nearly 25 pc Indian firms feel workforce ready for AI as adoption accelerates
description: 25% of Indian firms feel workforce-ready for AI, down 12 points, while adoption surges. 81% of leaders worry about skills gap. Kyndryl report reveals trust & governance challenges.
